item.title: Russian air strikes hit Southern Bridge in Kyiv again, mayor says
item.description: Russian air strikes have again hit the Southern Bridge in the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian air strikes have again hit the Southern Bridge in the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram on Friday. On Thursday, Russian drones [USN:L1N45N05F TEXT:"smashed"] into a school in Kyiv and into the Southern Bridge over the Dnipro River, triggering fires in the capital, as Moscow continues its nearly daily, around-the-clock strikes on Ukraine. Traffic across the bridge and another one, the Paton Bridge, was closed in both directions, authorities in Kyiv said, as they were redirecting transports via alternative routes. A fire broke out in the top floors of an apartment building in Kyiv, in addition to damage in another part of the city and the Southern Bridge, Klitschko added. In Russia, Ukrainian drones [USN:P8N44K00A TEXT:"targeted"] industrial facilities in the city of Volgograd, home to a large oil refinery, sparking a fire and leaving one person injured after hitting an apartment building, a governor said. Ukraine's strikes on oil refineries in Russia, one of the world's leading oil producers, have [USN:L6N45N11I TEXT:"cost"] Russia 1% of its gross domestic product, President Vladimir Putin has said, as people were forming [USN:L6N44O0M9 TEXT:"long lines"] to refill their car tanks amid the damage.

item.title: ベネズエラ石油輸出、9月は9％減 海上運賃上昇受け
item.description:
Marianna Parraga Mircely Guanipa
[１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Marianna Parraga　Mircely Guanipa

[１日 ロイター] - ベネズエラの９月の石油輸出が日量１０８万バレルと、前月比で約９％減少したことが、１日の海運データで分かった。海上輸送コストの上昇を相殺するため、商社が国営石油会社ＰＤＶＳＡに値引きを求めたことが影響した。

ビトルやトラフィグラなど大手商社は９月、海上運賃の上昇で利益率が縮小する中、ベネズエラ産原油の値引き拡大を要求し始めた。これがタンカーの航路変更を招き、前月以前からの輸送遅延がさらに積み上がった。

商社や海運関係者によると、こうした状況は１０月もベネズエラ産原油の需要に影響を及ぼすとみられている。

米軍が１月にマドゥロ大統領を拘束して以降、ベネズエラの石油輸出は米政府の監督下に置かれている。９月の米国向け輸出は日量６２万９０００バレルと、８月の５５万３０００バレルから増加した。

一方、タンカーの動向に基づくデータによると、インド向けは日量２５万３０００バレルと、８月の２９万７０００バレルから減少。欧州向けも２６万バレルから約８万６０００バレルに減った。一方、カリブ海の貯蔵ターミナル向けは６万バレルから７万６０００バレルに増えた。

item.title: India's Cockroach Janata Party, student groups to protest, demand poll chief's resignation
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will face renewed pressure on Friday as the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janata Party and a separate coalition of student and activist groups stage fresh protests, demanding the resignation of the elections commission chief over a controversial voter roll revision.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will face renewed pressure on Friday as the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janata Party and a separate coalition of student and activist groups stage fresh protests, demanding the resignation of the elections commission chief over a controversial voter roll revision. The CJP will rally in Mumbai and plans to expand demonstrations nationwide in the coming days, while student and civil society groups will gather at New Delhi's Jantar Mantar. The protests mark the latest escalation in a dispute that has put unprecedented scrutiny on India's Election Commission, long regarded as one of the country's most trusted institutions. The protesters' main allegation is that the commission manipulated voter rolls in ways that favour Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). The commission and the government have denied the allegations. Pressure on Election Commissioner [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar"] intensified last month after the Indian Express newspaper reported the [USN:L4N45K0E7 TEXT:"election chief's two deputies"] had formally raised concerns at least 14 times over the past 10 months over voter-list revisions, registration procedures and the commission's digital systems. The Election Commission has said differing views are a normal part of internal deliberations and that all its actions were lawful. "We have been asking and demanding for a change but nothing of that is going to happen, if our only tool that is left to change anything in our society 'the right to vote' is taken away from us," Saurav Das, CJP's convenor, told Indian news agency ANI on Thursday. "We will only end the protest after Gyanesh Kumar resigns." The controversy centres on a nationwide voter-verification exercise launched last year that critics say has led to millions of eligible voters being removed from electoral rolls. The commission says the exercise is intended to remove duplicate, deceased or ineligible voters and ensure the accuracy of electoral rolls. Opposition parties led by the Congress party are also set to begin protests demanding Kumar's resignation on October 6. The CJP, a youth movement that emerged earlier this year from online frustration over unemployment and leaked examination papers, has become an unexpected political force. Led by [USN:L4N43P1JI TEXT:"Abhijeet Dipke"], the party gained national prominence after spearheading mass protests over [USN:L4N43O0C9 TEXT:"exam-paper leaks"] that led to the resignation of India's education minister, one of Modi's most significant political setbacks in recent years.

item.title: Myanmar ships with returnees from Malaysia enter home waters, state media says
item.description: Nearly 1,500 Myanmar nationals sent back from Malaysia aboard navy ships are expected to reach the war-torn country's commercial hub of Yangon within days, state media reported on Friday, despite warnings from the United Nations and rights groups that the returnees could be at risk amid a raging civil war.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nearly 1,500 Myanmar nationals [USN:L6N45L0GD TEXT:"sent back"] from Malaysia aboard navy ships are expected to reach the war-torn country's commercial hub of Yangon within days, state media reported on Friday, despite [USN:L1N45F0FJ TEXT:"warnings"] from the United Nations and rights groups that the returnees could be at risk amid a raging civil war. Three Myanmar navy vessels carried 1,476 Myanmar nationals into Myanmar waters on Thursday, the Global New Light of Myanmar newspaper reported. The nationals have been repatriated from Malaysian immigration detention camps after serving sentences for illegal stays and violating immigration regulations. The United Nations [USN:L6N45M0GV TEXT:"has said"] conditions in Myanmar "do not support the safe and sustainable return of refugees", although Malaysia [USN:L6N44O0RX TEXT:"insists"] that the process is strictly voluntary. The UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in Myanmar, Kelley E. Currie, said on Thursday that she was "gravely concerned". She urged Malaysia to stop the repatriations and work with the UN to address the situation of Myanmar refugees. Myanmar has been in turmoil since a military coup in 2021 ousted an elected civilian government, triggering a civil war in the impoverished Southeast Asian country. Myanmar's junta chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing will [USN:L6N45M0O5 TEXT:"visit Malaysia"] this month, Malaysian state media reported, as the two countries continue talks [USN:L6N4580O7 TEXT:"on returning refugees"] and people displaced by conflict. Naval personnel and Myanmar authorities have provided the returnees with medical care, meals and clothing during the voyage, state media reported. Family members and local authorities will meet the returnees at the port in Yangon and arrange transport to their hometowns, state media said, adding that those returning would get further help to resettle. State media featured interviews with three unnamed returnees, two of whom said they had been held in Malaysian immigration detention prior to their return. It was not immediately clear whether any members of the Muslim minority Rohingya community were among the returnees, the first group to be sent back as part of [USN:L6N43W0NK TEXT:"a repatriation plan"] involving up to 5,000 people. Malaysia has stepped up immigration enforcement in recent years amid rising local hostility against refugees, particularly the Rohingya, many of whom fled Myanmar after a 2017 military crackdown that is being investigated for genocide offences at the International Court of Justice.

item.title: Plankton bloom turns Thai island waters a bright, smelly green
item.description: Heavy rains and floods helped spark a plankton bloom that kept some swimmers on shore in the popular tourist island of Ko Lan.
item.dc:creator: Napat Wesshasartar
item.content:encoded: The sea off Thailand's popular tourist island of Ko Lan turned a bright, pungent green this week as heavy rains and floods helped spark a plankton bloom that kept some swimmers on shore. Dense patches of green could be seen stretching along parts of the coast, with jet skis floating in discoloured waters around the island in the northern part of the Gulf of Thailand, while other stretches of the shoreline were unaffected. "What we're actually seeing with the naked eye is a colour that comes from a type of plankton called Noctiluca," said Arvut Munhapon, a senior researcher and head of marine environmental research at the Marine Science Research Division, Institute of Marine Science, Burapha University. His team of four was on the ground collecting water samples, measuring water quality, and bringing samples back to the lab to identify species and build a database that would help form a clearer picture of the situation. Plankton blooms are a natural, recurring phenomenon, but have worsened around the world as climate change has warmed seas, the researchers said. Fertiliser runoff and nutrient-rich wastewater also wash into the sea and feed rapid plankton growth, they said. Blooms typically last two to three days. When they end, mass plankton die-off consumes oxygen and sometimes creates hypoxic conditions, or an "aquatic dead zone", with oxygen levels too low to support marine life, according to Anukul Buranapratheprat, deputy director of the Institute of Marine Science, Burapha University. "We're looking at the endpoint, which is hypoxia ... and hypoxia in the inner Gulf of Thailand, based on my own research, has genuinely gotten more severe," Anukul said. His biggest concern was a wide hypoxic zone that had formed this year, too low in oxygen to support bottom-dwelling marine life. This year's monsoons and El Niño may be intensifying both the bloom and this year's hypoxic conditions, since warmer water holds less dissolved oxygen, but Anukul said more research was needed to confirm the connection. Significant [USN:L6N45L06Y TEXT:"flooding"] has hit Thailand in recent weeks, including in central provinces and Bangkok, adding to the volume of freshwater reaching the Gulf. Food vendors along the beach said customer numbers had thinned since the green water appeared, with some visitors moving to unaffected areas of the island. The discolouration was enough to keep others out of the sea altogether. "I felt that it was unusually green compared to normal seawater, so I didn't dare go in. I was afraid I'd break out in a rash,” Latipeya Thantibhapat, a 29-year-old tourist from Chiang Mai, told Reuters.

item.title: Cancer survivor Maddinson earns Australia test call-up
item.description: Australia have added Nic Maddinson to their test squad for the three-match series against South Africa, putting the 34-year-old batter in contention for a remarkable comeback little more than a year after undergoing treatment for testicular cancer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia have added Nic Maddinson to their test squad for the three-match series against South Africa, putting the 34-year-old batter in contention for a remarkable comeback little more than a year after undergoing treatment for testicular cancer. Maddinson was called up alongside reserve wicketkeeper Sam Harper after Josh Inglis was [USN:L6N45I025 TEXT:"ruled out"] of the first test, which begins in Durban on October 9, with a fractured finger. Maddinson's inclusion comes amid growing injury problems for the tourists, who are also monitoring Cameron Green after he suffered an abdominal strain during the third One-Day International against South Africa. "Sam gives us wicketkeeping cover as Josh continues his recovery while Nic provides flexibility throughout the batting order," chief selector George Bailey said. Maddinson played three tests in 2016 but has not featured in the format in almost a decade and has yet to play a first-class match since undergoing chemotherapy following a cancer diagnosis last year. Despite not playing Sheffield Shield cricket last season, the left-hander was named New South Wales captain for the current campaign and scored a century in the One-Day Cup last week. Harper has earned his first senior Australia call-up after strong recent form, including a century for Australia A, and will provide cover for first-choice wicketkeeper Alex Carey.

item.title: Amazon seeks to offload $8 billion of Nvidia chips to investors, FT reports
item.description: Amazon is seeking to offload about $8 billion of advanced Nvidia chips to investors through a new vehicle to strengthen its balance sheet, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Amazon (AMZN.O) is seeking to offload about $8 billion of advanced Nvidia (NVDA.O) chips to investors through a new vehicle to strengthen its balance sheet, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. In recent weeks, Amazon has held talks with investors to gauge interest in the deal that would move thousands of Grace Blackwell chips it is installing in US data centres into a special-purpose vehicle, the report said. The cloud giant will then lease the advanced AI chips back from the SPV, which would tap outside investors through debt issuance, the FT said, adding that the company could adopt a more asset-light approach to its balance sheet by unloading the expensive semiconductors to investors. Amazon plans to offer an equity stake of up to 10% in the vehicle, the newspaper said. The chips in the proposed deal were bought or leased by Amazon. They are installed in more than a dozen US data centres across five states, including Nevada and Virginia, the report said. Amazon and Nvidia did not immediately respond to Reuters for comment outside regular business hours.

item.title: Kraken send Flames to their worst-ever home-opening defeat
item.description: Vince Dunn scored once in a three-point performance and Jared McCann produced three assists as the visiting Seattle Kraken rolled over the Calgary Flames with a 6-1 victory in the season opener for both clubs on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Vince Dunn scored once in a three-point performance and Jared McCann produced three assists as the visiting Seattle Kraken rolled over the Calgary Flames with a 6-1 victory in the season opener for both clubs on Thursday. Kaapo Kakko and Matty Beniers both scored once and added an assist, while Jordan Eberle, Freddy Gaudreau and Chandler Stephenson also tallied for the Kraken, who rode a three-goal first period to the win. Seattle goaltender Joey Daccord made 24 saves and was credited with an assist. Ryan Strome scored for the Flames, while goalie Dustin Wolf stopped 26 shots in the expected final season opener at the Saddledome. It was the Flames' worst-ever defeat in a home opener. The clubs will meet again on Sunday in Seattle, after both play other opponents on Saturday. Eberle opened the scoring on a power play, the first of two goals 32 seconds apart just before the midway point of the opening period. He set up shop at the front of the net and buried the loose puck on a rebound chance at 9:10. Dunn doubled the lead right after. The puck came to him at the blue line, and his blast from the point rang off the post and into the net. It was the third consecutive year Dunn scored in the season opener. Gaudreau wrapped up a perfect opening frame for the Kraken by making it a 3-0 game when he buried Kakko's cross-ice feed off the rush 30 seconds before the first intermission. Stephenson extended Seattle's lead at 3:13 of the third period when he slid home a chance on a partial breakaway. Beniers made it a five-goal edge 51 seconds later with a one-timer from the left circle. Strome finally gave the hosts and their faithful something to celebrate when he buried a shot from the left circle with 3:25 remaining in regulation. However, Kakko rounded out the scoring 26 seconds later by chipping home a rebound chance. --Field Level Media

item.title: Browns blow 11-point lead, rally past Steelers
item.description: Andre Szmyt booted a career-long 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds remaining to lift the Cleveland Browns to a 27-24 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Andre Szmyt booted a career-long 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds remaining to lift the Cleveland Browns to a 27-24 victory over the visiting Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday night. Deshaun Watson completed 24 of 33 passes for 268 yards, one touchdown and one interception as Cleveland stands 3-1 for the first time since 2021. Jaleel McLaughlin and Quinshon Judkins rushed for touchdowns and Harold Fannin Jr. had a scoring catch for the Browns. Denzel Boston had 89 yards on four catches as Cleveland won its third straight game. Grant Delpit and Denzel Ward had interceptions and the Browns sacked Aaron Rodgers five times. Delpit picked off Rodgers' last throw with one second left to seal it. Rodgers was 22-of-40 passing for 299 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions for the Steelers (2-2). Jaylen Warren had 126 scrimmage yards (93 rushing, 33 receiving), DK Metcalf had five receptions for 115 yards and Roman Wilson, Darnell Washington and Pat Freiermuth had scoring receptions. Pittsburgh star T.J. Watt had a forced fumble, a recovery and a sack and Robert Spears-Jennings had an interception for the Steelers. Rodgers drove Pittsburgh 80 yards on eight plays and hit Freiermuth on a 3-yard scoring pass with 1:42 left. Rodgers then converted the two-point conversion on a quarterback sneak to tie it at 24 with 1:42 remaining. Watson then moved the Browns 36 yards on seven plays to set up Szmyt's decisive kick. Pittsburgh trailed by 11 entering the fourth quarter before Spears-Jennings helped flip the momentum with his interception at the Pittsburgh 23-yard line. The Steelers responded by moving 77 yards on six plays. Rodgers hit Washington for a 21-yard scoring pass with 10:10 to play, but the two-point conversion failed, leaving Pittsburgh down 21-16. Szmyt tacked on a 44-yard field goal with 6:37 remaining to boost the Cleveland lead to eight. The first time Pittsburgh had the ball, it put together a 17-play, 78-yard drive that lasted 9:48. Wilson scored the touchdown on the jet sweep when Rodgers flipped the ball forward to him and he raced 12 yards with 2:59 left in the first. Cleveland equaled the score in the second quarter when McLaughlin scored on a 28-yard run with 12:14 remaining. The Browns later moved ahead 14-7 when Judkins scored from the 2 with 8:28 left. Cleveland stretched its lead to 14 when Watson tossed a 2-yard scoring pass to Fannin with 1:22 left. Pittsburgh's Chris Boswell booted a 31-yard field goal with eight seconds left as the Steelers trailed 21-10 at the break. --Field Level Media

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-米、対エジプト軍事支援の人権条件免除 イラン戦争踏まえ
item.description:
Alexander Dziadosz Patricia Zengerle Humeyra Pamuk
[カイロ／ワシントン／イスタンブール １日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Dziadosz　Patricia Zengerle　Humeyra Pamuk

[カイロ／ワシントン／イスタンブール １日 ロイター] - 米国務省は１日、エジプトへの３億ドル超の軍事支援について、人権に関する条件の適用を免除したと明らかにした。米国による対イラン戦争開始以降、エジプト政府が果たしてきた「有益な役割」を考慮したという。

エジプトは１９７９年のイスラエルとの平和条約締結を機に米国から大規模な支援を受けるようになり、１９８０年代後半以降は年間約１３億ドルの軍事支援を得ている。

支援の一部には人権や民主主義に関する条件が付されているが、国家安全保障上の理由で適用を免除できる。バイデン前政権下などで支援資金の拠出が見送られ、過去には両国政府の摩擦につながった。

ロイターが確認した９月２１日付の議会各委員会宛て書簡では、ルビオ国務長官が「２０２５会計年度のエジプト向け対外軍事資金３億２０００万ドルについて、認定要件を免除する決定を下した」とされている。

国務省はその後、免除したことを確認した。

決定の理由を説明する９月４日付の添付文書によると、この支援は「テロ対策、国境警備、または不拡散計画に必要であるか、その他の点で米国の国家安全保障上の利益にとって重要」と判断された。

ルビオ氏の署名が入ったこの文書は「特に『エピック・フューリー（壮絶な怒り）作戦』以降にエジプトが果たしてきた有益な役割を踏まえると、この免除権限の行使は米国とエジプトの関係、および米国の国家安全保障上の優先課題にとって不可欠だ」としている。

エピック・フューリー作戦は、米軍が２月下旬にイスラエルと共に開始した対イラン軍事作戦の名称。文書にはエジプトの「有益な役割」の具体的な説明はなかった。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ブレーブスがワイルドカードＳ突破、ドジャースとの地区Ｓへ
item.description: ［１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［１日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は１日、ワイルドカードシリーズの１試合を行い、ブレーブスがフィリーズを下して２０２３年以来の地区シリーズ進出を決めた。

１勝１敗で迎えたこの日の第３戦は、ブレーブスが初回にマイケル・ハリス外野手の３ランで先制。その後もオジー・アルビーズ二塁手の２ランなどで得点を重ねたブレーブスは、フィリーズの反撃をしのいで６─２の勝利を収めた。

ブレーブスとドジャースの地区シリーズは、３日からドジャースの本拠地で開幕する。

item.title: Developing countries hit by overlapping crises, UNDP chief warns
item.description: Rising energy costs, a super El Nino and soaring borrowing costs are increasing pressure on developing countries, with conditions nearing those of the pandemic when the G20 suspended debt payments for the poorest nations, the United Nations Development Programme said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: Rising energy costs, a super El Nino and soaring borrowing costs are increasing pressure on developing countries, with conditions nearing those of the pandemic when the G20 suspended debt payments for the poorest nations, the United Nations Development Programme said on Friday. Global policymakers are expected to discuss the huge challenges facing developing countries at the annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank in the Thai capital Bangkok from October 12 to 18, UNDP Administrator Alexander De Croo told reporters. He warned events could trigger a "domino effect with many, many countries being pushed into financial distress," but stopped short of calling for a new round of debt relief. The IMF-World Bank meetings will bring together top financial officials from around the world for talks on the global economy, AI, climate change and other challenges, as [USN:L8N45N0KW TEXT:"government borrowing costs"] hit their highest in several decades on heightened concerns about inflation as the Iran war drives up energy prices. At the same time, the [USN:L6N45F0NL TEXT:"strongest El Nino"] weather effect since 1950 is expected to trigger more floods in some regions and droughts in others, plunging an expected 49 million more people into food insecurity by the end of 2027. De Croo said UNDP surveys conducted since the start of the war showed it had morphed from a regional conflict to "a crisis which has an impact on approximately 100 countries." Many governments have taken steps to shield their citizens from the surge in oil prices but their fiscal coffers are now running low and their debt levels are rising, with no real relief in sight, he said, adding that countries should focus on measures to help the most vulnerable. While some countries were diversifying their energy sources and adapting their food systems, those efforts would take time, leaving them in a "really tough, tough spot" for now, he said. SUBSIDY BURDEN UNDP Chief Economist George Gray Molina said a major shift was seen in September, as some governments began to allow higher energy prices to flow through to citizens, and started rolling back subsidies, tax relief and other steps that had kept food and energy prices largely in check since the war began. "That means that they're not able to contain fiscally and financially that burden," he said. "We think that this is a significant issue that needs to be discussed." Even middle-income countries had rapidly depleted their fiscal buffers as they raced to mitigate rising energy prices, he said. Molina said bond market and oil price developments over the next 60 days would be crucial. Higher prices had already contributed to protests and social unrest in 10 countries in September, UNDP said. And many countries expect conditions to deteriorate. Twenty-two of 26 nations surveyed by UNDP rated the crisis as a high or medium priority; 13 said it came on top of an existing economic or fiscal crisis, and all 26 judged that the worst was still to come.

item.title: US job growth expected to slow in September; unemployment rate likely steady
item.description: US job growth likely slowed in September and the unemployment rate is forecast to have been 4.1% for a third straight month, suggesting the labor market remained stable heading into the fourth quarter.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: US job growth likely slowed in September and the unemployment rate is forecast to have been 4.1% for a third straight month, suggesting the labor market remained stable heading into the fourth quarter. The anticipated moderation would follow a surprise jump in [USN:L1N44W0EC TEXT:"nonfarm payrolls in August"], which economists partly attributed to volatility linked to the model the government uses to strip out seasonal fluctuations from the data. The Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics will publish its closely watched employment report on Friday. "I am expecting a reaffirmation of the 'low-hire, low-fire' American labor market," said Joe Brusuelas, chief economist at RSM. "At this point, we're at full employment, and I think there will be nothing in the jobs report that will cause the [USN:L6N45N16X TEXT:"Federal Reserve"] to change its bias from one more hike this year." Nonfarm payrolls likely increased by 90,000 last month after surging by 162,000 in August, a Reuters survey of economists predicted. Estimates ranged from as low as 35,000 to as high as 180,000. Economists expected August's job count, which was the largest in five months, to be revised down. The initial payrolls print for August has typically been weak, making this year's jump an anomaly. "We suspect that the seasonally adjusted August nonfarm payroll print will be revised down as the BLS extends its seasonal adjustment procedure forward to incorporate the September data," said Marc Giannoni, chief US economist at Barclays. "The seasonal adjustment significantly exaggerated that month's employment gain. Had the August nonfarm payroll employment been adjusted with the August 2025 seasonal factors, it would have registered a drop of 74,000 jobs." Economists said there were no signs yet that the US-Israel war with Iran was disrupting the labor market. But they expected the growing headwinds from the conflict in the Middle East, including high energy prices and strained supply chains, to start having an impact by the end of this year. Diesel prices are at record highs and could start to exert pressure beyond the transportation and agricultural sectors. Ongoing tariffs also are a source of concern, with an [USN:S0N44H001 TEXT:"Institute for Supply Management"] survey on Thursday showing rising anxiety among manufacturers over the trade war with Canada. Robust corporate profit growth and resilient domestic demand are for now shielding workers from layoffs. Historically low layoffs account for labor market stability, with hiring at a modest level. "There's just too many negative things playing out in terms of problems with fuel prices, uncertainty over the political outlook and trade policies," said Brian Bethune, an economics professor at Boston College. "I wouldn't be surprised if employment hits the wall next month." AI INVESTMENT SUPPORTING MANUFACTURING, CONSTRUCTION Economists expected a moderation in employment growth in the leisure and hospitality industry as well as local government education after large gains in August. Another month of strong increases is forecast for construction payrolls, partly driven by the building of data centers to support AI technology. A fourth straight month of double-digit employment gains is expected for the manufacturing sector, also in part related to the infrastructure buildout for artificial intelligence. Economists also said it was unclear when the termination of Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Haitian immigrants would show up in the data. "Our base case is that this will likely play out gradually over a period of months as a mild headwind to payroll growth rather than as a one-time shock," said Shruti Mishra, an economist at Bank of America Securities. "The impact should be cushioned by alternative legal status for some workers, gradual employer adjustment, and persistent labor shortages in several affected sectors." Together with worker retirements, the Trump administration's immigration crackdown, which also includes deportations, has reduced labor supply, helping to keep a lid on the unemployment rate. The economy needs to create between 50,000 and 80,000 jobs per month to keep up with growth in the working-age population, economists estimated. Economists said a low jobless rate should not be mistaken for a tight labor market, adding that the focus should be on wage growth. Wages are forecast to have increased 3.2% on a year-over-year basis in September after rising 3.1% in August, indicating that the labor market is not a source of inflation. The US central bank [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"last month raised"] its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead. The odds of another rate hike this month were diminished by cooler-than-expected [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation readings"] for August and July. Financial markets are pricing in a roughly 28% chance of further monetary policy tightening at the US central bank's October 27-28 meeting, down from about 69% a week ago, CME Group's FedWatch tool showed. "An unemployment rate that falls because of lower participation due to demographic forces is not necessarily a tightening labor market that is generating upward pressure on wages," said Veronica Clark, an economist at Citigroup.

item.title: 欧州企業、第3四半期は19.4％増益見通し 伸び鈍化へ
item.description: [１日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳが１日公表したデータによると、アナリストは欧州主要企業の第３・四半期利益が前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州企業、第3四半期は19.4％増益見通し　伸び鈍化へ 12:50 配信

ドイツのフランクフルトで2021年10月25日撮影　 REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[１日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳが１日公表したデータによると、アナリストは欧州主要企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比１９．４％増になると予想している。主にエネルギー部門がけん引するものの、増益率は第２・四半期から鈍化する見通しだ。

エネルギー部門を除くＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数構成企業の増益率は９．９％となる見込み。景気循環型消費財メーカーの伸びが最も大きく、テクノロジー部門がこれに続くとみられている。アナリストはテクノロジー部門の増益率予想を７月時点の１３．１％から２３．８％に引き上げた。

• エネルギー部門は９８．６％の増益が見込まれているが、第２・四半期の１３８．６％から伸びが鈍化する見通し。

• 同部門の高い増益率を支えているのは燃料価格だ。北海ブレント価格は９月に約１４％上昇し、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）の精製マージンは過去最高を記録した。

• 不動産部門は前年同期比７１．４％の減益と、最も大幅な落ち込みが予想されている。

• ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種構成企業の売上高は１０．６％増、エネルギー部門を除くと４．３％増となる見通し。４部門で減収が見込まれている。

• 指数構成企業で最初に決算を発表したスウェーデンのファッション小売大手Ｈ＆Ｍは、一時的な米関税の還付により利益が予想を上回ったものの、売上高は伸び悩んだ。

• アナリストは指数構成企業の第４・四半期については３５．１％の増益を予想している。ただ、同指数は債券利回りの上昇を受け、四半期初日に１．３％下落した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：年初来安値圏のユーロ、今後の鍵はエネルギー価格と高まる政治リスク コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 アングル：欧州の中銀関係者、米国との協調維持に不安　市場介入に懸念 アングル：欧州の猛暑、経済損失は過去最大規模の恐れ　観光の変化で南欧に大打撃 アングル：欧州熱波、マクロ経済面からの市場注目ポイント 最終更新: 10/2(金) 12:50 ロイター

item.title: 韓国大統領、ウクライナに追加措置警告 北朝鮮兵の移送公表巡り
item.description:
Kyu-seok Shim
[ソウル ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kyu-seok Shim

[ソウル ２日 ロイター] - 韓国の李在明大統領は２日、ウクライナが北朝鮮兵２人の移送について秘密保持で合意していたことを認め、謝罪しなければ、追加措置を取ると警告した。具体的な内容には踏み込まなかった。

李氏はＸへの投稿で「事実を認め、公に謝罪することを拒み続けるなら、われわれは追加措置を取る」と述べた。

また、韓国と北朝鮮の間で軍事衝突が差し迫っているとするウクライナ側の発言について、朝鮮半島での戦争をあおるものだとして「深い遺憾」を表明した。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が９月の国連総会で、ロシア側で戦っていた際に捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に移送したと公表して以降、韓国とウクライナの間では外交上の対立が続いている。

韓国は、兵士の身の安全を守るため移送を非公開にするという合意にウクライナが違反したと非難。一方、ウクライナ当局者はそうした合意は存在しないと主張している。

韓国統一研究院のチョ・ハンボム上級研究員は、追加措置が取られる場合、人道・財政・復興支援など、韓国が既にウクライナに提供している支援に関するものになる可能性が最も高いと指摘。「ウクライナは韓国から支援を受けているため、韓国よりも失うものが大きい」と述べた。

韓国は２０２２年のロシアによる侵攻以降、ウクライナに人道・財政支援を提供しており、今年７月の北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）首脳会議の際には、殺傷力のある兵器を含まない支援として１億ドルの追加拠出を表明した。

チョ氏は一方で「対立が長引けばどちらの利益にもならない」と述べ、韓国は北朝鮮の軍事活動に関する情報をウクライナに依存していると指摘した。

item.title: African Union urges Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to refrain from actions that could undermine stability
item.description: The African Union Commission has called on Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to exercise maximum restraint and refrain from actions or statements that could worsen tensions and undermine regional peace and stability.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The African Union Commission has called on Ethiopia, Eritrea and Egypt to exercise maximum restraint and refrain from actions or statements that could worsen tensions and undermine regional peace and stability. "The Commission urges the three countries to address their differences through established diplomatic channels and peaceful dialogue," it said in a statement late on Thursday. On Thursday, Ethiopia ordered the closure of its embassy in Eritrea and declared 10 Eritrean diplomats persona non grata, prompting Asmara to sever all diplomatic ties with its neighbour. It also declared an Egyptian diplomat persona non grata and ordered him to leave the country within 48 hours, and Cairo responded in kind by declaring an Ethiopian embassy counsellor in Egypt persona non grata and giving him 48 hours to leave.

item.title: Reports: Jalen Duren returning to Pistons on 5-year, $200m deal
item.description: All-NBA center Jalen Duren is returning to the Detroit Pistons on a fully guaranteed, five-year, $200 million contract, ESPN and The Athletic reported on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: All-NBA center Jalen Duren is returning to the Detroit Pistons on a fully guaranteed, five-year, $200 million contract, ESPN and The Athletic reported on Thursday. Duren, 22, had been a restricted free agent. The two sides had failed to broker a deal for months, with Detroit reportedly offering less in part due to dissatisfaction with Duren's playoff performance last spring. The first-time All-Star and All-NBA player saw his numbers sag to 10.2 points and 8.5 rebounds per playoff game. That came on the heels of his averaging a career-high 19.5 points with 10.5 rebounds over a regular season that resulted in the Pistons finishing with the Eastern Conference's top record at 60-22. Detroit lost in the Eastern Conference semifinals in seven games to the Cleveland Cavaliers. The organization reportedly offered Duren the same $200 million deal in recent days, but with the addition of a weight clause. The new agreement reportedly removed that clause. A first-round choice (13th overall) in the 2022 draft, Duren has played his entire four-year career in Detroit. He has career averages of 13.5 points, 10.3 rebounds and 2.1 assists. --Field Level Media

item.title: Abdul-Malik Olajuwon, son of Hakeem, commits to SMU
item.description: Abdul-Malik Olajuwon, a four-star shooting guard recruit in the Class of 2027 and the son of Hall of Famer Hakeem Olajuwon, committed to SMU on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Abdul-Malik Olajuwon, a four-star shooting guard recruit in the Class of 2027 and the son of Hall of Famer Hakeem Olajuwon, committed to SMU on Thursday. The younger Olajuwon plays at IMG Academy in Florida but grew up in a suburb of Houston, where his father spent 17 of his 18 NBA seasons with the Rockets and became a franchise icon. He also starred collegiately for the "Phi Slama Jama" Houston Cougars before the Rockets selected him first overall in the 1984 NBA Draft. Abdul-Malik Olajuwon did not hold a reported offer from the Cougars, choosing SMU over Minnesota (where he also took an official visit), Kansas State, Virginia Tech and others. He is rated as the No. 66 overall player and No. 4 shooting guard in his class by the 247Sports composite rankings. "Coach (Andy) Enfield is a laid-back guy, but he's intense," the younger Olajuwon told ESPN. "He's not a yeller or a screamer, but he gets his point across. When he talks, the gym becomes silent. Everyone listens to him and respects him. "My dad was with me on the visit and feels that this is a great decision for me. I also leaned on my older brother, who's been through the process and told me not to think only about basketball, but to think long-term." Hakeem Olajuwon's older son Aziz is an incoming freshman at Stanford and was considered a top-100 recruit in the Class of 2026. --Field Level Media

item.title: 「ドキュメンタリーで見たことあった」 フライドバイ機の乗客、操縦かん引き上げ墜落阻止
item.description: テルアビブ行きのフライドバイ機内で副操縦士が機長を刺し、機体が急降下する事態が発生した際、容疑者を取り押さえた乗客の1人だったヤニブ・ハユンさん（50）が緊迫の瞬間について語った。ハユンさんは航空事故に関するドキュメンタリー番組で見た知識を活かし、操縦かんを引いて機体を立て直したという。イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は血のついた服のまま帰国したハユンさんらを「英雄」と称え、大統領民間英雄賞に推薦した。ハユンさんは汚水ポンプ会社を経営しており、妻と2人の娘とともに旅行中だったという。

item.title: Japan does not need excessively loose monetary policy, economy minister says
item.description: Japan is no longer experiencing deflation so does not need excessively loose monetary policy for the pursuit of a higher inflation rate, Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Japan is no longer experiencing deflation so does not need excessively loose monetary policy for the pursuit of a higher inflation rate, Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi said on Friday. Monetary policy decisions are the jurisdiction of the Bank of Japan, Kiuchi added, declining to comment on whether the government opposed further central bank interest rate hikes. "Japan has emerged from an era where it needed the kind of reflationist policies taken under Abenomics," Kiuchi said at a regular news conference, adding that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's policies were different from the massive stimulus introduced by former premier Shinzo Abe in 2013. "What I mean to say is that Japan is no longer in a deflationary period, and therefore does not need excessively loose policy that pursues inflation," Kiuchi said. Kiuchi made the remarks in response to reporters asking about a [USN:L1N45N00D TEXT:"summary of opinions"] of the BOJ's September policy meeting, which showed a government representative called for caution over further interest rate hikes. The remarks add to commentary from the government dismissing the viewpoint that it was pursuing reflationist policies to bolster demand through expansionary fiscal and monetary steps. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on [USN:L1N45L02L TEXT:"Tuesday"] she made it clear to US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent last week that the prime minister was not a reflationist. Kiuchi is widely regarded as reflationist due to his past caution towards interest rate hikes and association with a group of lawmakers that called for expansionary spending.

item.title: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro ponen a Caixa en el centro de sus planes para aliviar la deuda en Brasil
item.description: Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro coinciden en recurrir al banco estatal para aliviar la deuda de los consumidores, mientras Caixa amplía su papel en el crédito y la vivienda en Brasil.
item.dc:creator: Cristiane Lucchesi, Matheus Piovesana, Daniel Carvalho
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Mientras Brasil se encamina hacia unas elecciones muy reñidas, sus candidatos a la presidencia están dando a conocer propuestas para ayudar a hacer frente a la creciente deuda de los consumidores. El presidente de Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, anunció la semana pasada un programa de alivio de la deuda de 150.000 millones de reales (US$29.000 millones) que rivalizaba con un paquete similar presentado días antes por su principal oponente, el senador Flávio Bolsonaro. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil 2026: qué proponen Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro en economía, seguridad y energía Hay un aspecto concreto de sus planes que coincide: el papel de Caixa Econômica Federal, un gigantesco banco estatal cuyo tamaño se ha disparado en los últimos años. La Caixa, una entidad crediticia más conocida por gestionar las prestaciones sociales habituales, así como por su enorme cartera de préstamos inmobiliarios, ha pasado a ocupar un lugar central en las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil, ya que ambos candidatos intentan hacer frente a una economía que podría estar entrando en una fase de desaceleración. Parte de sus planes tiene como objetivo abordar la carga de la deuda de los consumidores con la ayuda de la Caixa. Quienquiera que gane las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil asumirá el control de la Caixa, que ha desempeñado un papel central en la financiación de la vivienda en Brasil durante casi cuatro décadas y se ha expandido en los últimos años para trabajar también con prestatarios de clase media. La entidad cuenta con la mayor cartera de crédito registrada en Brasil, con 1,4 billones de reales, y millones de brasileños la utilizan para percibir prestaciones por desempleo. El banco, que por sí solo representa casi el 70% de las hipotecas en Brasil, ya es el principal prestamista del programa de Lula “Mi Casa, Mi Vida”, cuyo objetivo es ofrecer tasas de interés subvencionados a los consumidores con rentas más bajas. La financiación de la iniciativa ha aumentado hasta superar los 200.000 millones de reales este año, frente a los 75.000 millones de reales del último año del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, padre de Flávio. Ver más: Brasil ante las elecciones: qué pasaría con el ajuste fiscal, la inflación y el real si gana Lula o Bolsonaro En el marco del nuevo programa de alivio de la deuda de Lula, que entra en vigor de inmediato, el gobierno comprará a las entidades crediticias los préstamos impagados con un descuento de al menos el 90%, para luego ofrecer mejores condiciones de pago a los prestatarios. Caixa y otro banco de propiedad estatal, el Banco do Brasil SA ( BBAS3 ), pueden llevar a cabo estas operaciones y gestionar dichas carteras. Flávio Bolsonaro anunció una propuesta muy similar días antes, afirmando que recurriría a Caixa para ayudar a los consumidores. Su principal asesora económica es Daniella Marques, quien anteriormente ocupó el cargo de consejera delegada de dicha entidad. El dinero para el plan de Bolsonaro procedería de un enorme fondo de 3 billones de reales denominado “SOS Brasil” que él crearía, financiado con nuevos ingresos del petróleo, los ingresos de la titulización y los activos inmobiliarios del gobierno, según afirmó. A pesar de la falta de detalles, la propuesta de Bolsonaro supone un cambio con respecto al enfoque de su padre durante su último mandato: reducir la participación de los bancos estatales en la economía tras años de expansión durante los anteriores gobiernos del Partido de los Trabajadores. Bajo el gobierno de Jair Bolsonaro, la cartera de préstamos de Caixa creció menos que la de sus competidores, mientras que la financiación estatal destinada a un programa de vivienda similar para personas con bajos ingresos, denominado “Casa Verde y Amarilla”, se redujo de 77.000 millones de reales en 2018 a 69.000 millones de reales en 2021. Caixa también se desprendió de participaciones y negocios. En febrero de 2019, el banco se desprendió de sus acciones en la compañía de reaseguros IRB Brasil Resseguros SA, por entonces la mayor de Latinoamérica. Posteriormente, Caixa vendió su participación restante en el Banco Pan SA al Banco BTG Pactual SA y sacó a bolsa una participación minoritaria de su división de seguros, Caixa Seguridade Participações SA. “Es poco probable que cambie el papel de Caixa como motor del crecimiento en el mercado inmobiliario, independientemente de quién forme el próximo gobierno”, afirmó Julyana Yokota, directora general de S&P Global Ratings. “Lo que sí podría cambiar, y eso depende realmente de la agenda política, ya sea del gobierno actual, si permanece en el poder, o de una nueva administración, es el ritmo de crecimiento de la cartera de préstamos y el grado en que el próximo gobierno utilice a Caixa como instrumento para fomentar el crecimiento económico”. Ver más: ¿Qué impacto pueden tener las elecciones de Brasil en los activos argentinos? Contar con una entidad crediticia capaz de ofrecer a los consumidores tasas de interés inferiores a las del mercado también puede resultar crucial, dado que el país se enfrenta a una desaceleración económica. La actividad económica global descendió un 0,22% en julio con respecto al mes anterior, lo que supone el segundo descenso consecutivo. Los impagos de préstamos personales han alcanzado nuevos máximos, según datos de agosto. Esto cobra aún más importancia si se tiene en cuenta que, en los últimos años, los competidores de la Caixa han evitado financiar inmuebles de menor valor a través del sistema habitual de financiación de la vivienda en Brasil, que limita las tasas de interés al 12% anual para viviendas de hasta 2,25 millones de reales. Esta tasa se sitúa actualmente por debajo de la tasa de referencia fijada por el Banco Central de Brasil, que es del 13,75%. Los préstamos del programa “Mi Casa, Mi Vida” tienen tasas de interés que oscilan entre el 4% y el 10%. “Si la Caixa ha obtenido mejores resultados en los últimos dos o tres años es porque cuenta con un pequeño motor que funciona muy bien: el mayor programa de vivienda patrocinado por el Estado del mundo”, afirmó Tainan Costa, analista inmobiliario de UBS BB Investment Bank, en una entrevista. Dado que Caixa está controlada por el gobierno, la forma en que el presidente decida gestionar la institución constituye una parte importante de su agenda económica, lo cual representa una de las principales preocupaciones de los inversores, teniendo en cuenta las difíciles perspectivas fiscales de Brasil. Ver más: Brasil enfrenta nuevas amenazas por importaciones de acero aunque cae la participación de China Durante el tercer mandato de Lula, la cartera inmobiliaria de Caixa aumentó aproximadamente un 58%, financiada tanto por el FGTS, un fondo de trabajadores gestionado por el gobierno, como por los propios depósitos del banco. Los anteriores gobiernos del Partido de los Trabajadores inyectaron fondos públicos en el capital del banco para impulsar actividades como la concesión de préstamos a empresas, algo de lo que la Caixa se ha abstenido en gran medida desde entonces. “La expansión del crédito en la Caixa en esta ocasión no se produjo de forma agresiva, como sí ocurrió en otros gobiernos del Partido de los Trabajadores”, afirmó Alexandre Albuquerque, analista de Moody’s Ratings, en una entrevista. “En esta ocasión, Caixa se esforzó por mantener la eficiencia y unos niveles de capitalización adecuados, y también se esmeró en buscar sus propios instrumentos de financiación”, añadió. Caixa es líder en productos de ahorro y otros productos de financiación, lo que le permite ofrecer préstamos más económicos a los clientes incluso al margen del programa gubernamental, aunque su rentabilidad también es menor que la de sus competidores. Una parte significativa del negocio de Caixa consiste en ofrecer hipotecas a los consumidores, que suelen ser préstamos a más de 30 años. En general, este negocio está en pleno auge. Los bancos concedieron préstamos por valor de 21.000 millones de reales en julio, lo que supone un aumento mensual del 21%, según Abecip, una asociación de entidades de crédito inmobiliario. Más del 47% de ese total procedía de Caixa. Esas cifras excluyen fuentes como el FGTS e incluyen también la financiación a empresas inmobiliarias. “Es cierto que existen enfoques distintos sobre cómo gestionar un banco de propiedad totalmente estatal como Caixa”, afirmó Albuquerque, de Moody’s. “No es ningún secreto para nadie que, durante la anterior administración, la prioridad se centró más en la reducción de plantilla”. -Con la colaboración de Martha Beck. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Three homers send Braves past Phillies, into NLDS matchup with Dodgers
item.description: ATLANTA -- Michael Harris II, Ozzie Albies and Matt Olson homered and six Braves pitchers stifled the Philadelphia Phillies' offense, allowing Atlanta to roll to a 6-2 victory in the decisive third game of a National League wild-card series Thursday evening.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ATLANTA -- Michael Harris II, Ozzie Albies and Matt Olson homered and six Braves pitchers stifled the Philadelphia Phillies' offense, allowing Atlanta to roll to a 6-2 victory in the decisive third game of a National League wild-card series Thursday evening. The Braves got all their runs they needed on Harris' three-run first-inning homer off Aaron Nola (0-1), winning their first winner-take-all postseason game since Game 7 of the 1996 NL Championship Series against the St. Louis Cardinals. It also snapped Atlanta's six-game losing streak in elimination games that dated back to the 2018 NL Division Series against the Los Angeles Dodgers. Atlanta will face the Dodgers in a best-of-five NLDS starting on Saturday in Los Angeles. The Phillies' losing streak in winner-take-all games was extended to four games, with their only such victory coming in the 1980 NLCS. The loss also snaps Philadelphia's four-year streak of reaching at least the NLDS round. Ray Kerr got the start for Atlanta as an opener, delivering 3 1/3 scoreless innings of one-hit work in his postseason debut. Grant Holmes (1-0) followed with his own postseason debut, giving up one run on two hits over two innings. Robert Suarez, Didier Fuentes, Dylan Dodd and Game 1 starter Chris Sale combined to allow one run on three hits over the final 3 2/3 innings. For Sale, who threw 6 1/3 innings on Tuesday, it was his first relief appearance since he closed out the 2018 World Series for the Boston Red Sox, aside from a bulk-relief appearance in 2026 during Charlie Morton's Atlanta sendoff. Sale struck out Bryce Harper to end the eighth, then worked a scoreless ninth. The Braves scored first for the first time in the series when Harris lined a 2-0 sinker just over the right field fence after walks by Ronald Acuna Jr. and Olson, staking Atlanta to a 3-0 lead in the first. Albies tacked on in the fourth when he smashed a 419-foot two-run homer to right off Zach Wheeler, extending the lead to 5-0. The Phillies, after getting nothing out of a two-on, no-out scenario in the fifth, got onto the board in the sixth on Alec Bohm's RBI groundout after Kyle Schwarber singled and Harper doubled. Atlanta got the run back in the seventh on Olson's solo homer. Philadelphia's Derek Hill hit a leadoff triple in the eighth, and Trea Turner's sacrifice fly brought him home. Both teams finished with six hits, but the Phillies went 0-for-6 with runners in scoring position. --Curt Weiler, Field Level Media

item.title: 独半導体インフィニオン、タイに新半導体工場 総事業費14億ドル
item.description: [バンコク １日 ロイター] - ドイツ半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは１日、タイに新工場を開設した。タイは...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独半導体インフィニオン、タイに新半導体工場　総事業費14億ドル 12:15 配信

インフィニオンのロゴ。ドイツのドレスデンで６月撮影。REUTERS/Matthias Rietschel

[バンコク １日 ロイター] - ドイツ半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは１日、タイに新工場を開設した。タイは東南アジア域内の競争激化を背景に、半導体産業への投資誘致を推進している。

• バンコク近郊にある新施設は半導体の組み立て・検査などを担う後工程拠点。初期投資額は１億ユーロ（１億１３５７万ドル）超。

• タイ投資委員会（ＢＯＩ）の声明によると、プロジェクトの総額は１４億ドル。

• インフィニオンのアレクサンダー・ゴルスキ最高執行責任者（ＣＯＯ）によると、同拠点は開設当初、半導体製造に必要な制御環境であるクリーンルームを最大３万平方メートル備え、将来的には１５万平方メートルまで拡張可能だという。

• ゴルスキ氏は「これは戦略的な長期投資だ」と述べ、中国などの主要市場への近さをタイの強みとして挙げた。

• 同氏によれば、インフィニオンは米国、欧州、中国と東南アジアに１３カ所の製造拠点を持ち、既存のクリーンルーム容量を活用すれば、売上高を倍増させる可能性もある。

• タイでの事業拡張はまた顧客にデュアルソーシングを提供するための取り組みの一環でもある。ゴルスキ氏は「マレーシアの工場で何らかの問題が発生しても、タイ工場を通じて顧客をサポートすることができる」と説明した。

• ＢＯＩのナリット事務局長は、半導体分野における長期戦略の一環として、フォトニクス、パワー半導体、センサーに重点を置き、２０３０年までに１８０億ドルの半導体投資の誘致を目指していると表明した。

item.title: 台湾にＦ１６Ｖ戦闘機到着へ、数カ月遅れ 米中首脳会談1週間後
item.description:
Ann Wang
[台東（台湾） ２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ann Wang

[台東（台湾） ２日 ロイター] - ２０１９年に発注された６６機の新型Ｆ１６Ｖ戦闘機のうち、最初の２機が数カ月の遅れを経て２日に台湾に到着する。中国軍を監視するためにほぼ毎日緊急発進（スクランブル）を余儀なくされている台湾空軍の強化が図られることになる。

台湾の顧立雄国防部長（国防相）は立法院（国会）で記者団に対し、まもなく他のＦ１６Ｖも到着すると説明。「もちろん、年末までに納入されるのはこの２機だけではない」と述べた。

米国は１９年、ロッキード・マーチン製のＦ１６Ｖを台湾に８０億ドルで売却することを承認。この契約により、台湾のＦ１６シリーズは２００機以上に増えることになる。しかし、ソフトウエアの問題などを理由に機体の引き渡しは遅れが生じ、台湾当局は繰り返し不満を表明していた。

最初の２機の到着は米中首脳会談からほぼちょうど１週間後となる。

中国政府は、台湾への武器供与を停止するよう米国に繰り返し求めてきた。中国外務省はＦ１６Ｖの到着に関するコメント要請に応じなかった。

item.title: Gas Malaysia targets investment decision on Kedah LNG terminal by second half of 2027
item.description: Gas Malaysia aims to make a final investment decision on plans for its first regasification terminal by the second half of next year, with the facility due to come online by the end of 2030, its chief executive said.
item.dc:creator: Ashley Tang
item.content:encoded: Gas Malaysia (GASM.KL) aims to make a final investment decision on plans for its first regasification terminal by the second half of next year, with the facility due to come online by the end of 2030, its chief executive said. The proposed terminal, first announced in March, is being [USN:FWN41S0UW TEXT:"jointly developed"] with Japan's Tokyo Gas (9531.T) and Dutch group VTTI at an estimated cost of between 2 billion ringgit and 3 billion ringgit ($490 million to $735 million). Slated to be constructed in the Yan district of the northern state of Kedah, it would be the first liquefied natural gas (LNG) import facility in Peninsular Malaysia not built by state energy firm Petronas. Petronas operates two regasification terminals in the peninsula’s south, with a third being developed in the western state of Perak. Sarawak's state-owned Petros has recently also announced plans to build an [USN:L1N45N03K TEXT:"LNG import terminal"] in Sarawak with Norwegian firm Höegh Evi. Gas Malaysia CEO Azli Mohamed told Reuters in an interview its facility is aimed at filling a gap in gas distribution in Malaysia’s northern region. Malaysia, currently the world’s fifth-largest exporter of LNG, is expected to see an increase in domestic [USN:L4N44Z0OO TEXT:"gas power demand"], fuelled by a boom in data centre growth and broader economic expansion and amid a planned phasing out of coal-fired generation by 2044. Azli dismissed concerns about potential overcapacity in the region, citing Malaysia’s plans to deploy 9 gigawatts of new gas-fired power generation capacity by 2032. “If you do the math, there are definitely strong requirements and needs for importing LNG through various different terminals, and I think we fit into that equation," Azli said. The project by Gas Malaysia, the country's sole supplier of reticulated natural gas in Peninsular Malaysia, is expected to be capable of producing up to 6 million tons per annum. The firm plans to focus on LNG imports to strengthen energy security in Peninsular Malaysia for now, but does not rule out future pipeline gas exports to neighbouring countries like Thailand, Azli said. He also noted expectations of a more liberalised gas market, after an agreement governing supply and pricing arrangements between Petronas and the power generation sector expires next year. Market liberalisation would be a key step toward Malaysia eventually becoming a net LNG importer, which could happen within 10 to 15 years or even sooner, Azli said. As the country's first market-determined LNG import facility, the terminal will allow Gas Malaysia, which currently sources its gas from Petronas, the option to purchase from other suppliers, he added. Malaysia imported 2.42 million metric tons of LNG and exported 27.03 million metric tons in 2025, according to the government's statistics department. Pricing policies for the power sector after 2028 are set to be crucial for Gas Malaysia. Malaysia currently subsidises prices at which gas is sold to the power sector, while other industries pay market prices. "The policy moving forward... would have an impact in terms of how we can be competitive throughout the value chain," Azli said. ($1 = 4.0840 ringgit)

item.title: 異次元緩和は終了、高市政権の政策は狭義のリフレではない=城内経財相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
[東京 ２日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は２日の閣議後会見で、日銀の大規...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
異次元緩和は終了、高市政権の政策は狭義のリフレではない=城内経財相 12:06 配信

城内実経済財政相。都内で9月18日撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２日 ロイター] - 城内実経済財政相は２日の閣議後会見で、日銀の大規模な金融緩和「異次元緩和（ＱＱＥ）」やイールドカーブコントロール（ＹＣＣ）は終わっており、「狭義のリフレ政策はすでに終わっている」と指摘した。    　城内氏は９月に記者会見で「アベノミクス的な意味でのリフレ政策は終了している」と説明してきた。金融市場では、金融緩和による日銀の国債買い入れに依存する大規模財政出動をリフレ政策と解釈する向きもあるため、リフレ政策終了の真意を記者が確認した。    　城内氏は、「現状はデフレではない」と指摘、アベノミクスはデフレから脱却するためのリフレ政策であり、成長戦略により供給力を高める高市政権の経済政策サナエノミクスとは異なるとの持論を繰り返した。同時に「アベノミクスの一部は継承している」とも発言した。

item.title: ウクライナ外相、韓国との「誤解」解消望む 北朝鮮兵の移送公表巡り
item.description: [１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１日 ロイター] - ウクライナのシビハ外相は、ロシアとの戦争で捕虜にした北朝鮮兵２人の移送を公表したことで生じた韓国との対立について、関係修復に取り組んでいると明らかにした。ウクライナのメディアが１日報じた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、先週の国連総会演説で捕虜２人を韓国に移送したと表明。非公表を想定していた韓国が抗議した。

ニュースサイト「ｎｖ．ｕａ」などによると、シビハ氏は記者団に「これを事件とは呼びたくない。外交上の誤解と言っておこう」と述べた。

その上で「この状況がごく近い将来に解決するよう強く望んでおり、それに取り組んでいる。われわれにとって韓国は重要な国だ。ともに真に達成しつつある関係の前進、その継続、具体的な成果に大いに期待している」と述べた。

韓国大統領府は今週、移送の公表を巡ってウクライナに説明と謝罪を要求。両国が秘密保持で合意していたとした上で、ウクライナがそれを否定したのは事実に反すると指摘した。

韓国政府高官によると、韓国側は、安全保障上、外交上、捕虜や家族の安全を含む人道上の懸念から、移送を秘密にするよう求めていた。

item.title: Latin America most exposed to any US ban on diesel exports, Goldman Sachs says
item.description: Goldman Sachs said on Friday that Latin America would be the region most exposed to any US ban on diesel exports.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs said on Friday that Latin America would be the region most exposed to any US ban on diesel exports. Imports from the US account for more than 50% of diesel consumption in Ecuador, Chile, Mexico and Peru, it said in a note. Here are some details: The brokerage said a sudden cutoff of US supply could lower GDP by around 1% in Latin America, although inventory buffers and increased exports from the rest of the world would dampen these effects. "Supply will likely adjust quickly given the global nature of diesel markets, so in practice the main global economic impacts will come from higher diesel prices," it added. [USN:L4N45K04P TEXT:"Goldman Sachs"] estimates that a US diesel ban would lower retail diesel prices by $0.25 a gallon per week of export bans, implying a modest 2-3 basis point drag on headline US inflation after a month. On Wednesday, US President Donald Trump [USN:L6N45M1CX TEXT:"said"] he has conversations about banning diesel exports "every day" as the White House races to curb soaring energy prices. The Trump administration has told [USN:L6N45N0J6 TEXT:"Germany and France"] to draw down emergency diesel inventories to help ease soaring global fuel prices or face a potential US diesel export ban, according to three people close to the discussions. Goldman Sachs estimates that each sustained 10% increase in diesel prices would raise global headline inflation by 0.1 percentage point and core inflation by 0.03 percentage point, with larger effects in Emerging Market Asia and Europe.

item.title: South Korea's Lee threatens action against Ukraine over transfer of North Korean soldiers
item.description: President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified measures unless Kyiv acknowledged what Seoul says was a confidentiality agreement covering the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers.
item.dc:creator: Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung on Friday threatened unspecified measures against Ukraine unless Kyiv acknowledged what Seoul says was a confidentiality agreement covering the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers and apologises. "If the refusal to acknowledge the facts and issue a public apology continues, we will take additional measures," Lee said in a post on X. Lee also expressed "grave regret" over what he described as Ukrainian remarks about an imminent military clash between North and South Korea, saying they amounted to encouraging war on the Korean Peninsula. Seoul and Kyiv have been locked in a diplomatic dispute since Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy announced at the United Nations General Assembly last month that Ukraine had transferred two North Korean prisoners of war captured while fighting for Russia to South Korea. Seoul subsequently accused Kyiv of violating an agreement to keep the transfer confidential in order to protect the soldiers, while Ukrainian officials said no such agreement existed. Ukraine was seeking to [USN:L1N45N18S TEXT:"mend ties"] with South Korea, Ukrainian media reported on Thursday, quoting Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha. "I would not like to call this an incident. Let's say, it's a diplomatic misunderstanding," Sybiha told journalists at an event, according to a report on news website nv.ua and other media. The dispute comes at a sensitive time for Lee's administration, which has sought to reduce tensions with North Korea and is also dealing with political fallout from a recent landmine incident in the Demilitarized Zone. Cho Han-bum, a senior fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification in Seoul, said any additional measures would most likely involve support South Korea already provides to Ukraine, including humanitarian, financial and reconstruction assistance. "Ukraine has more to lose than South Korea because it is receiving support from Seoul," Cho said. South Korea has provided humanitarian and financial assistance to Ukraine since Russia's 2022 invasion and in July pledged an additional $100 million in non-lethal support on the sidelines of the NATO summit. "However, neither side benefits from a prolonged confrontation," Cho said, noting that South Korea relies on Ukraine for information related to North Korea's military activities.

item.title: Blake Coleman finds net in Wild debut, helps take down Predators
item.description: Blake Coleman scored in his team debut, and the Minnesota Wild held on for a 3-1 win over the host Nashville Predators on Thursday evening.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Blake Coleman scored in his team debut, and the Minnesota Wild held on for a 3-1 win over the host Nashville Predators on Thursday evening. Nick Foligno and Kirill Kaprizov also scored for Minnesota, which never trailed in its regular-season opener. Quinn Hughes logged a team-high 27:30 of ice time and tallied an assist. Roman Josi scored the lone goal for Nashville. Filip Forsberg and Steven Stamkos had one assist apiece. Wild goaltender Jesper Wallstedt stopped 19 of 20 shots to earn the victory. He is expected to earn the bulk of playing time as fellow netminder Filip Gustavsson is sidelined by an injury. Predators goaltender Juuse Saros allowed three goals on 30 shots. The Wild opened the scoring with 10:25 remaining in the first period. Michael McCarron fired a shot that Saros stopped, but a big rebound kicked out to Foligno in the slot. Foligno took advantage with a wrist shot that beat Saros before he could recover. About four minutes later, Minnesota made it 2-0 on the power play. Bobby Brink slid a pass toward the front of the crease for Coleman, who shifted the puck from his backhand to his forehand and punched a shot into the net. The play marked a highlight in the team debut for Coleman, who joined the Wild during the offseason after spending the previous five seasons with the Calgary Flames. Nashville cut the deficit to 2-1 with 10:37 to go in the second period. Josi set up in the right circle and blasted a one-timer past Wallstedt to bring the home crowd to its feet. Hughes orchestrated a goal that put the Wild ahead 3-1 with 15:18 remaining in the third period. Hughes handled the puck near the blue line and snapped a wrist shot, which Kaprizov redirected past Saros and into the back of the net. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＩＣＣ、アクサとの保険契約終了 背景にトランプ米政権の制裁
item.description: [１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１日 ロイター] - 国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）の広報担当者は、フランスの保険大手アクサとの契約を１日付で終了し、今後は別の保険会社を利用することを明らかにした。ロイターに対して「相互の合意に基づき、契約関係を終えることを決定した」とコメントしたものの、理由には言及していない。新たに利用する保険会社の名前も伏せた。

トランプ大統領はパレスチナ自治区ガザへの攻撃を巡ってＩＣＣがイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相に逮捕状を出したことを批判。ＩＣＣを「邪悪」で「ならず者の機関」だと主張し、他国に対してＩＣＣから離脱するように促している。米国は既にＩＣＣ職員に対して金融制裁やビザ（査証）発給停止を課しており、当局者はロイターに対して、ＩＣＣの運営能力を損なう可能性のある制裁措置を準備していると語っていた。

先に報じた英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）の記事によると、アクサは「米国の制裁措置の域外適用によるリスク」を理由に挙げたとし、これが「企業にとってますます緊迫し、複雑化している国際情勢」を反映したものだとしている。

ＦＴは事情に詳しい情報筋の話として、アクサが数カ月にわたって社内およびＩＣＣと回避策について協議を重ねたと説明。しかしＥＵ域内企業が米国などの第三国の制裁に従うことを禁じたＥＵの「ブロッキング規則」が適用されない限り、解決策を見いだすことはできなかったと報じた。

アクサはロイターからのコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

item.title: 午前の日経平均は反落、利益確定優勢 米雇用統計前で様子見も
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比０．９１％（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は反落、利益確定優勢　米雇用統計前で様子見も 11:52 配信

東京証券取引所。２０２０年１０月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比０．９１％（６３０円００銭）安の６万８３２６円７２銭となった。前日までの大幅高の反動で利益確定売りが優勢となり、指数寄与度の大きいＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株や主力株が下落。日経平均は一時１％超安となった。一方、今晩の米雇用統計公表を控え様子見姿勢も広がり、前場終盤にかけてはもみ合いが続いた。

・日経平均は前営業日比０．９３％安でスタートした後、一時１．２％（８２４円）安の６万８１３２円１６銭まで下落。その後は６万８４００円を軸にもみ合い。

・前日に買われたＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株や主力銘柄の一角が軟調。寄与度の大きいソフトバンクグループは５％超安。プライム市場では８割超の銘柄が下落し、全体的に売りが先行。

・米国が中東に部隊と空母を増派するとの報道などを受けて、原油価格が上昇。日本企業の業績懸念につながり、相場の重しに。

・物色面では電線株が堅調。光ファイバー関連の企業群が資金調達や長期契約の締結を発表し、先々の需要拡大を好感する買いが入ったとの見方も。その他、ＳａａＳ（ソフトウエア・アズ・ア・サービス）関連株も上昇。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは１．０３％安の４０８９．２６ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は４兆０９８７億８２００万円。

・東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、鉱業、石油・石炭製品など４業種が値上がり。証券、商品先物取引、輸送用機器、情報・通信など２９業種は値下がりした。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが２０３銘柄（１３％）、値下がりは１３２６銘柄（８５％）、変わらずは２３銘柄（１％）。

＜岩井コスモ証券　投資調査部フェロー　有沢正一氏＞

「きょうは半導体関連株で利益確定売りが出ているが、売りをこなした後は再びしっかりした展開を想定。特に決算シーズンに入れば、業績を手掛かりに上方向を試す動きになるとみている」

「物色面では、引き続きＡＩ関連株や金融株に注目。この２つが循環して買われる相場展開を見込む」
